title: 第17章 天墟第18章 和谐的一幕
lines: 纸鹤聚拢了一团云雾，裹挟着飞动着，遮掩了日月星光。
而目的就是为了更方便的入睡，这倒不是许平秋提出来的，而是乐临清的想法。
开始许平秋有些错愕，在他的想象中，乐临清都能主动辟谷，那还需要入睡吗？
不是打打坐，吐纳吐纳灵气，不仅能修行，还能取代睡眠，精神一整天？
面对许平秋的内卷发言，乐临清表示修行最重要的就是顺心，正所谓‘欲静则平气，欲神则顺心’，而睡觉就很顺乐临清的道心。
于是，乐临清扒拉着许平秋，在他身上，靠到一个舒服的姿势，许平秋则搂着乐临清靠在了白虎软乎乎的肚皮上，白虎则咸鱼的趴在了纸鹤上。
在经过一番无昼无夜的睡眠，一觉醒来，许平秋觉得乐临清说的也不是不无道理。
乐临清迷糊从许平秋怀中坐起，晃了晃头，青丝在许平秋脸上甩来甩去，口中无意识的发出了“嗯”，“晤”的声响，令许平秋感觉一阵酥麻入骨。
随后她慵懒的伸了个懒腰，双手高展，体态前倾，许平秋有些惋惜，若不是有白布缠绕，或许就能瞥见雪上重霄之绝景。
“就快到啦。”乐临清无视了许平秋的目光，挥手将云雾驱散，顿时一阵金光便映照而来，恰似万千金丝垂落人间。
许平秋不由得眯起了眼。云层被日光染透，灿若金霞，一圈圆虹在澄碧天穹之上绽放，光色相参，恍惚间竟有不真之感。
云气浩荡入怀，吹得衣袖猎猎作响，遥见三座巍峨神山贯穿云雾，悬于天际，上通绝云，下临无地。
神山很大，上有重重观阁，横枕鳌峰，沐浴在万道霞光之中，白光熠熠，通体皆被氤氲曦光所笼，如若仙阙临空。
山腰处，更有栈道飞桥穿云而建，宛若凌空虚渡，于迷离云雾中若隐若现。时不时还有流光自神山之上浮起，仙禽盘桓，发出阵阵清越祥鸣。
许平秋和白虎渐渐的看愣住了，一人一虎的嘴都不由张开，像是惊掉了下巴。
纸鹤没有直接通往云中神山，而是向着下方飞去。
神山之下，乃是一片浩渺湖泽。湖面平滑如镜，水天交辉，碧色与青霄浑然一气，倒映出九天之上的壮丽奇景。
此刻，湖面正有不少扁舟，皆是朝着湖心一处岛屿缓缓划去。
舟上各立着一人，模样瞧去都很年轻，但令人奇怪的是，这些扁舟明明都是一样的，但有的吃水却更深。
甚至，许平秋还看见有的扁舟游到一半就渐渐沉没，上面的少年明明看上去很清瘦才是，不至于此。
然后湖面钻出一只很肥很肥很肥的锦鲤，将落水的人托起，向着岸边游去。
乐临清看出许平秋的疑惑，缓缓解释道：
“这是福缘舟，若是福缘不够，那么便会像这般沉没于水中，但被锦鲤托起后，哪怕不能入仙门，余生也能安稳一些。”
“这样啊，所以这是入宗考核之一？”许平秋若有所思的问道，看起来似乎自己正巧遇到天墟招生选拔了。
只是听到福缘两字，许平秋多少有点慌，他抽卡就没有不保底过，这只怕一上舟，锦鲤都来不及救自己，直接创造最速沉底传说。
“嗯呀，不过我可以直接带你跃过这关，毕竟你是天脉，福缘肯定不浅。”乐临清微微颔首，纸鹤没有停留在岸边，而是直接向着湖中心的岛屿飞去。
“那就好。”许平秋微微松了口气，他害怕自己一不小心成为天脉之耻。
纸鹤载着许平秋提前到达了岛屿，许平秋从纸鹤上跃下，白虎也紧跟其后，它着实有些不想在天上飘了。
乐临清见状，也没有阻止，只是对许平秋说道：“我只能送你到这里了，接下虽然有考验，但我觉得对你来说不是问题。”
她言语中对许平秋充满信心。
content_en:
The paper cranes gathered into a cloud of mist, enveloping them and flying around, covering up the sun, moon and stars.
The purpose was to make it easier to fall asleep. This was not Xu Pingqiu's idea, but Le Linqing's idea.
Xu Pingqiu was a little surprised at first. In his imagination, Le Linqing could take the initiative to live without grain, so did he still need to fall asleep?
Isn’t it true that meditating and breathing in and out spiritual energy can not only practice spiritual practice, but also replace sleep and keep you energetic throughout the day?
Facing Xu Pingqiu's speech in the inner volume, Le Linqing said that the most important thing in practice is to be at ease with the mind. As the saying goes, "If you want to be quiet, you will calm down your energy, and if you want to be spiritual, you will be at ease with your mind." And sleeping is very attuned to Le Linqing's Taoist mind.
So, Le Linqing pulled Xu Pingqiu and leaned on him into a comfortable position. Xu Pingqiu hugged Le Linqing and leaned on the white tiger's soft belly, while the white tiger lay on the paper crane.
After waking up after a day and night sleep, Xu Pingqiu felt that what Le Linqing said was not unreasonable.
Le Linqing sat up in Xu Pingqiu's arms in a daze, shook his head, and the black hair was swung back and forth on Xu Pingqiu's face, and he unconsciously said "um" and "me" in his mouth, which made Xu Pingqiu feel numb in his bones.
Then she stretched lazily, stretched out her hands, and leaned forward. Xu Pingqiu felt a little regretful. If it weren't for the white cloth wrapped around her, she might have been able to catch a glimpse of the stunning scenery of the sky above the snow.
"We're almost there." Le Linqing ignored Xu Pingqiu's gaze and waved his hand to disperse the clouds. Suddenly, a burst of golden light shone down, like thousands of golden threads falling down on the earth.
Xu Pingqiu couldn't help but narrowed his eyes. The clouds were dyed through by the sun, shining like golden clouds, and a circle of rainbows bloomed in the clear blue sky. The light and color were so consistent that it felt unreal in a trance.
The clouds were so vast that they blew into my sleeves, and I could see three majestic sacred mountains piercing the clouds and mist, hanging in the sky, with clouds above and no ground below.
The sacred mountain is very large, with many viewing pavilions on it, lying across Aofeng, bathed in thousands of rays of light, white light shining, and the whole body is enveloped in the dense sunlight, like a fairy tower in the sky.
On the mountainside, there is also a plank road flying bridge built through the clouds, just like crossing the sky, looming in the blurred clouds and mist. From time to time, there are streams of light floating from the top of the sacred mountain, and fairy birds linger around, emitting bursts of clear and auspicious cries.
Xu Pingqiu and Bai Hu gradually became stunned. Their mouths opened involuntarily, as if their jaws dropped in shock.
The paper crane did not lead directly to the sacred mountain in the clouds, but flew downwards.
Under the sacred mountain is a vast lake. The surface of the lake is as smooth as a mirror, the water and the sky are in perfect harmony, and the blue color and the blue sky are in harmony, reflecting the magnificent scenery above the nine heavens.
At this moment, there are many small boats on the lake, all rowing slowly towards an island in the center of the lake.
There is a person standing on each boat, and they all look young. But what is strange is that these small boats are obviously the same, but some have deeper drafts.
Xu Pingqiu even saw some small boats gradually sinking halfway through the swim. The young man on them obviously looked very thin, but that was not the case.
Then a very fat koi carp emerged from the lake, picked up the person who had fallen into the water, and swam towards the shore.
Le Linqing saw Xu Pingqiu's doubts and slowly explained:
"This is a lucky boat. If you don't have enough luck, it will sink in the water like this. But after being lifted up by the koi, even if you can't enter the immortal gate, you will be more stable for the rest of your life."
"Is that so? So this is one of the entrance examinations?" Xu Pingqiu asked thoughtfully, as if he happened to meet Tianxu's admissions selection.
Just hearing the word "Fu Yuan" made Xu Pingqiu a little panicked. He had never failed to guarantee his bottom when drawing a card. He was afraid that as soon as he got on the boat, the koi would not have time to save himself, directly creating the legend of the fastest sinking.
"Yeah, but I can take you directly to jump over this level. After all, you are a Tianmai, so you must have a lot of blessings." Le Linqing nodded slightly. The paper crane did not stay on the shore, but flew directly towards the island in the center of the lake.
"That's good." Xu Pingqiu breathed a sigh of relief. He was afraid that he would accidentally become the disgrace of Tianmai.
The paper crane carried Xu Pingqiu to the island ahead of schedule. Xu Pingqiu jumped off the paper crane, and the white tiger followed closely behind. It really didn't want to float in the sky anymore.
When Le Linqing saw this, he did not stop him. He just said to Xu Pingqiu: "I can only send you here. Although there will be tests in the next step, I don't think it will be a problem for you."
She was full of confidence in Xu Pingqiu in her words.
title_en: Chapter 17 Tianxu Chapter 18 A harmonious scene
